title: ClawMMU: Protection-Coherent Virtual Memory for Stateful LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.28093v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI agents keep long-term memory, much of which comes from web pages and tool results. Agent harnesses, the software that runs the model, do not record who may act on this memory, so an instruction hidden in a fetched page can be treated as the user's own instruction. We propose ClawMMU, a protection layer that labels every piece of memory with its owner, scope, origins, and authority. ClawMMU checks these labels whenever content enters the model's context, is written to storage, returns from storage, or drives a tool call. Its central rule is that information may rise in authority, but authority never lifts itself. Because the checks depend on where content came from, not on what it says, memory attacks become classical protection faults that the harness stops even when the model is fooled.

translated_title: ClawMMU：面向有状态LLM智能体的保护一致性虚拟内存
translated_abstract: AI智能体拥有长期记忆，其中大部分来自网页和工具返回结果。运行模型的软件（Agent harness）并不记录谁有权对这段记忆进行操作，因此隐藏在抓取网页中的指令可能被当作用户自己的指令来处理。我们提出ClawMMU，一个为每段记忆标注其所有者、作用域、来源和权限的保护层。每当内容进入模型上下文、被写入存储、从存储读回或驱动工具调用时，ClawMMU都会检查这些标签。其核心规则是：信息可以提升权限，但权限永远不会自我提升。由于这些检查取决于内容的来源而非其内容本身，记忆攻击变成了经典的保护错误，即使模型被欺骗，Agent harness也能将其拦截。
tldr: ClawMMU为LLM智能体的记忆引入基于所有权、来源和权限的标签保护机制，将记忆注入攻击转化为经典保护错误，使Agent harness在模型被欺骗时仍能可靠拦截。
en_tdlr: ClawMMU introduces a protection layer that labels LLM agent memory with ownership, origin, and authority, turning memory injection attacks into classical protection faults that the agent harness can stop even when the model is fooled.
